RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Unknown; a defensible number cannot be assigned from these facts.

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Your longer experience makes your disappointment understandable, but leadership appointments can also depend on client development, management skills and interview performance. The announcement may omit relevant qualifications.

Follow up on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, how your application was assessed, and feedback on leadership and commercial expectations.

Raise a discrimination concern if concrete evidence emerges—for example, sex-related remarks, inconsistent criteria or unequal treatment—not simply because of the panel’s composition. If you are considering legal action, check local deadlines promptly; waiting for feedback may not pause them.
